title: Pin DioTimeVerifier replay_counter composition with nonzero epoch
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py new DIO tests (~lines 439, 448) assert replay_counter equality/equality-to-2 using epoch 0 counters 1 and 2. A broken (epoch << 16) | seqnum composition (time_sync.py:433) would still produce 1 and 2 and pass. Add an assertion with a nonzero-epoch frame (e.g. counter (1<<16)|5) or pin a literal == 1 on the first sample.
